solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Prophetic fearful cry we hear is cosmetic

indicators.note: we hear tells us the phrase before it is to be taken by its sound

parts.note: fey can mean clairvoyant or doomed, and a scream is a fearful cry: a fey scream

explanation.surface: A soothsayer's terrified shriek is somehow described as a beauty product.
explanation.walkthrough: FEY means having second sight, so a prophetic scream is a FEY SCREAM, which said quickly sounds like the moisturiser.
explanation.definitionFit: A moisturising lotion for the skin is a standard cosmetic product.

clue.text: Much enjoyment getting around to bed

indicators.note: getting around says the word for enjoyment encloses the next piece

parts.note: much enjoyment is fun

explanation.surface: Someone having a great time finally makes it to bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A Japanese-style padded mattress, often on a low frame, used as a bed.

clue.text: Wreckage of boat, relic that's convertible

indicators.note: wreckage leaves the letters of the following words smashed and reassembled

explanation.surface: Salvage from an old boat turns out to be a relic that can be converted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wreckage of' scrambles BOAT and RELIC together.
explanation.definitionFit: A car with a folding roof is a convertible; cabriolet is the other name for it.

clue.text: Design of Arabic emperor in Spanish copper

indicators.note: a design of letters is a fresh arrangement of them

parts.note: Nero was a Roman emperor

explanation.surface: An Arabic pattern on a Spanish copper coin depicting an emperor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Design of' rearranges ARABIC with NERO. 'Copper' looks like the metal, but it is slang for a police officer.
explanation.definitionFit: A carabinero is a Spanish police officer, and copper is slang for a policeman.

clue.text: Star in waiting, the sun

parts.note: elect after a title, as in president-elect, means chosen and waiting to take office
Ra was the Egyptian sun god

explanation.surface: A celebrity biding their time in the sunshine.
explanation.definitionFit: Electra is one of the Pleiades, a named star in the cluster in Taurus.

clue.text: Show a prong piercing me

indicators.note: piercing puts the pronged piece inside the word for me

parts.note: taken as written
a tine is a prong of a fork or antler

explanation.surface: A sharp instruction: display a fork prong stuck into yourself.
explanation.definitionFit: An afternoon performance at a theatre or cinema is a type of show.

clue.text: Built to turn this way and that

indicators.note: turned this way and that, the letters read identically left to right and right to left

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Something was constructed to rotate in every direction.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is a palindrome, so it turns either way and stays the same.
explanation.definitionFit: To erect a building or shelf is to construct it, so erected means built.

clue.text: Drain shoe

definitions.meaning: to ... out a flooded cellar is to drain it
a light dancing shoe or court shoe

explanation.surface: A shoe dropped down the drain.
explanation.definitionFit: A pump draws liquid out, and a pump is also a plain light shoe.

clue.text: Beat journey in Buenos Aires trip?

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to beat them
to go is to journey

explanation.surface: Beating the trek to the Argentine capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trip' is the dancing sense, as in trip the light fantastic; the question mark flags that.
explanation.definitionFit: The tango is the dance of Buenos Aires, so a trip there is a dance step.

clue.text: Part of one's faithful dog? I'm not sure Rover needs it!

parts.note: a faithful dog plays the part, or role, of a pet: a pet role
um is the hesitant noise of someone unsure

explanation.surface: A musing on a loyal dog, with a doubt whether Rover needs it.
explanation.walkthrough: Rover looks like the classic dog's name, but it is the British car marque.
explanation.definitionFit: A Rover car runs on fuel refined from crude oil.

clue.text: Row around black river

indicators.note: around has the row enclosing the letter for black

parts.note: a tier is a row of seats
B is the pencil abbreviation for black

explanation.surface: A dark row of seats by the river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tiber is the river that flows through Rome.

clue.text: Is team drunk? Then clear the bar

indicators.note: drunk leaves the letters of is team reeling

parts.note: net means clear, as in profit after deductions

explanation.surface: A team accused of drunkenness is told to leave the pub.
explanation.definitionFit: An estaminet is a small French cafe serving drink, so a type of bar.

clue.text: Exciting and disgusting habit

definitions.meaning: a tense, thrilling finish is exciting
chewing one's fingertips is an unpleasant habit

explanation.surface: Something thrilling paired with a nasty habit.
explanation.definitionFit: A tense finish makes spectators gnaw their fingers, a habit many find disgusting.

clue.text: Card game very basic, did you say?

indicators.note: did you say marks the preceding phrase as heard rather than spelt

parts.note: so low means very basic, at a very low level

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a card game is really that elementary.
explanation.definitionFit: Solo whist is a card game usually called just solo.

clue.text: Soldiers having nothing to lose, reorganised after mobilisation

indicators.note: mobilisation sets the letters marching into a new formation
to lose says one piece is dropped from the letters before they are mixed

parts.note: O is the round figure for nothing

explanation.surface: Troops with nothing left to lose are regrouped once called up.
explanation.walkthrough: Take O from REORGANISED; 'after mobilisation' rearranges the remaining REGANISED letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Grenadiers are soldiers, originally those who threw grenades.

clue.text: Prison term starts alone, unfortunately — that's porridge!

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things gone awry, so the letters are jumbled
starts picks out the opening letters of prison and term

explanation.surface: A prisoner serving time alone is stuck on porridge.
explanation.walkthrough: PT plus ALONE are rearranged. Porridge is also British slang for a prison sentence, which the surface plays on.
explanation.definitionFit: Polenta is a porridge made from boiled cornmeal in Italian cooking.

clue.text: Savoury food after a lick, thrown up

indicators.note: after places the food word behind the reversed piece
thrown up, in a down light, means the letters are read bottom to top

parts.note: to lap is to lick
a table is the food served, as in keeping a good table

explanation.surface: Tasty food that is brought back up after a taste.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thrown up' reverses a down entry, reading it upwards; 'food' is the table you keep, as in keeping a good table.
explanation.definitionFit: Palatable means pleasant to taste, close to savoury in the sense of appetising.

clue.text: Award given to peer in a flap

indicators.note: given to places the award after the nobleman

parts.note: an earl is a peer of the realm
OBE is the British honour Officer of the Order of the British Empire

explanation.surface: A lord in a fluster about being honoured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In a flap' looks like panic, but the definition is a flap of flesh.
explanation.definitionFit: The soft fleshy lobe hanging from the ear is a flap of skin.

clue.text: Odd characters in tour having departed, ignite with a fresh spark

indicators.note: odd characters in names the first and third letters of tour
having departed says those odd letters leave, so the even ones remain
fresh signals a new arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: After strangers leave the tour, someone rekindles a fire.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping T and U from TOUR leaves OR; 'fresh' rearranges IGNITE and A.
explanation.definitionFit: To spark something is to start it off, to give rise to it.

clue.text: Some declare talent comes from the right side

indicators.note: comes from the right means read from right to left
some of the phrase means only a run of its letters is used

explanation.surface: People announce that real talent comes from the political right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' takes LARETAL from inside 'declare talent'; 'comes from the right' reads it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A lateral is a side branch or side pass, something off to the side.

clue.text: Plain female, one above punching subordinate

indicators.note: punching sends the two pieces into the middle of the word for subordinate

parts.note: less means lesser, of lower rank
I is the Roman numeral one
on means above, as in on top of

explanation.surface: An ordinary woman, ranked above, hits a junior.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plain' looks like plain-looking, but means grassland, where big cats live.
explanation.definitionFit: A female big cat roaming the African savanna plains.

clue.text: Establish the accuracy of indefinite figure invested in two companies?

indicators.note: invested in puts the figure inside the companies

parts.note: CO is short for company and a firm is a company
n is the algebraic symbol for an unspecified number

explanation.surface: Auditors verify an unknown sum put into two businesses.
explanation.definitionFit: To verify a claim is to check it is correct, to establish its truth.

clue.text: Show prowler, assuming undisguised

indicators.note: assuming means taking on, so the prowler wraps round the next word

parts.note: a cat prowls at night
bare means plain, undisguised

explanation.surface: A prowler is exposed once the disguise is dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: Cabaret is entertainment staged in a nightclub, a kind of show.

clue.text: Tramp is bitter

definitions.meaning: tramp in the slang sense of a promiscuous woman

explanation.surface: A vagrant who is resentful.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are dated slang for a loose woman, and sour or sharp-tasting.

clue.text: One never deviates as a sovereign

definitions.meaning: a straightedge for drawing lines never strays from straight

explanation.surface: A monarch who never strays from the line.
explanation.definitionFit: A measuring straightedge keeps lines true, and a monarch rules.

clue.text: Is the purpose of an auction so grim?

definitions.meaning: an auction exists for people to make offers

explanation.surface: Someone wonders if auctions are so gloomy because of their aim.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as two words, the answer gives the reason an auction is held.
explanation.definitionFit: A forbidding face is stern and unwelcoming, which is to say grim.

clue.text: Tongue licking other bottoms — yikes!

indicators.note: bottoms in a down light are the final letters of licking and other

parts.note: eek is a cry of alarm, like yikes

explanation.surface: A cheeky, shocked exclamation about rude licking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tongue' looks like the body part, but means a language.
explanation.definitionFit: Greek is a language, and tongue is an old word for a language.

clue.text: Key drug

definitions.meaning: the keyboard key marked with the # symbol

explanation.surface: A key drug, as if vital to a recipe.
explanation.definitionFit: The # key on a phone or keyboard, and a slang name for cannabis resin.

clue.text: Singer, a hoofer joining the party?

indicators.note: joining tacks the following pieces onto the end of the party

parts.note: a ball is a formal dancing party
a deer is a hoofed animal, so jokingly a hoofer

explanation.surface: A vocalist and a dancer arrive to join the party.
explanation.walkthrough: A hoofer is slang for a dancer, but here it is a creature with hooves.
explanation.definitionFit: A balladeer is a performer who sings ballads.

clue.text: First step of escalator behind lift

indicators.note: the first step of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: late means behind schedule

explanation.surface: Taking the first step onto an escalator, behind the lift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lift' looks like the elevator in an escalator scene, but it is a verb meaning cheer up.
explanation.definitionFit: To lift someone's spirits is to make them happy, to elate them.

clue.text: Leader moving to the far right in centre ground

indicators.note: moving to the far right sends the opening letter to the end of the word

parts.note: the heart is the centre of something
the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A political leader shifts to the far right while holding the centre ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Earth and ground both mean soil or the land underfoot.

clue.text: As if drunk, thus lying back on the roof

parts.note: a sot is a drunkard

indicators.note: lying back reverses the order of the letters

parts.note: so means thus
the peak is the top or roof

explanation.surface: A drunk sprawled back on the roof, so it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase qualifies a statement as figurative, much like as if or as it were.
